sentences.cn_text: 1807年至1814年间，伊比利亚半岛（包括西班牙和葡萄牙）成为一场规模空前、残酷无情的斗争的舞台。
sentences.en_text: Between 1807 and 1814 the Iberian Peninsula (comprising Spain and Portugal) was the scene of a titanic and merciless struggle.

sentences.cn_text: 这场斗争在多个层面展开：拿破仑的法国军队与愤怒的当地居民之间；英国人（他们总是热衷于加剧皇帝的困境）与从巴黎派来试图遏制他们的元帅之间；新兴的科学与精英制度力量与保守主义和血统的旧势力之间。
sentences.en_text: It took place on many different planes: between Napoleon’s French army and the angry inhabitants; between the British, ever keen to exacerbate the emperor’s difficulties, and the marshals sent from Paris to try to keep them in check; between new forces of science and meritocracy and old ones of conservatism and birth.

sentences.cn_text: 这也是一场密码编制者与密码破译者之间的较量——这一点甚至许多对该时期颇有研究的人都不知晓。
sentences.en_text: It was also, and this is unknown even to many people well read about the period, a battle between those who made codes and those who broke them.

sentences.cn_text: 几年前，我在阅读查尔斯·奥曼爵士的史诗巨著《半岛战争史》时，首次发现了拿破仑时期的密码战。
sentences.en_text: I first discovered the Napoleonic cryptographic battle a few years ago when I was reading Sir Charles Oman’s epic History of the Peninsular War.

sentences.cn_text: 在第五卷中，他附上了一篇附录「斯科维尔密码」。
sentences.en_text: In volume V he had attached an appendix, “The Scovell Ciphers”.

sentences.cn_text: 附录列出了许多从西班牙的法国军队中缴获的密码文件，这些文件的秘密被英国总部的一名军官乔治·斯科维尔破译。
sentences.en_text: It listed many documents in code that had been captured from the French army of Spain, and whose secrets had been revealed by the work of one George Scovell, an officer in British headquarters.

sentences.cn_text: 奥曼高度评价了斯科维尔的重要性，但与此同时，他的《半岛战争史》的整体性质使他无法仔细分析这位默默无闻的军官对国家间伟大斗争可能做出或未能做出的贡献，也无法向我们详细介绍这个人本身。
sentences.en_text: Oman rated Scovell’s significance highly, but at the same time, the general nature of his History meant that he could not analyze carefully what this obscure officer may or may not have contributed to that great struggle between nations or indeed tell us anything much about the man himself.

sentences.cn_text: 我渴望了解更多，但令我惊讶的是，1914年出版的奥曼附录竟是关于这场秘密战争唯一经过深思熟虑的著述。
sentences.en_text: I was keen to read more, but was surprised to find that Oman’s appendix, published in 1914, was the only considered thing that had been written about this secret war.

sentences.cn_text: 我逐渐确信，这个故事与二战中的恩尼格玛密码破译事件一样激动人心且意义重大。
sentences.en_text: I became convinced that this story was every bit as exciting and significant as that of Enigma and the breaking of German codes in the Second World War.

sentences.cn_text: 问题是，这个故事能否被讲述出来？
sentences.en_text: The question was, could it be told?

sentences.cn_text: 在伦敦公共档案馆研究斯科维尔的文件时，我发现他留下了一本详尽的日记和大量关于他在半岛工作的笔记。
sentences.en_text: Studying Scovell’s papers at the Public Record Office, London, I found that he had left an extensive journal and copious notes about his work in the Peninsula.

sentences.cn_text: 更重要的是，该收藏中保存了许多法军原始电文，我意识到这些资料价值连城。
sentences.en_text: What was more, many original French dispatches had been preserved in this collection, which I realized was priceless.

sentences.cn_text: 拿破仑战争期间可能有许多间谍和情报官员，但通常极难找到他们实际提供或处理过的材料。
sentences.en_text: There may have been many spies and intelligence officers during the Napoleonic Wars, but it is usually extremely difficult to find the material they actually provided or worked on.

sentences.cn_text: 在研究斯科维尔的故事时，我发现除了他的情报工作之外，还有更多引人入胜的内容。
sentences.en_text: As I researched Scovell’s story I found far more of interest besides his intelligence work.

sentences.cn_text: 他在威灵顿勋爵总部的地位以及他因工作所获得的认可，都与当时军队的阶级政治密切相关。
sentences.en_text: His status in Lord Wellington’s headquarters and the recognition given to him for his work were all bound up with the class politics of the army at the time.

sentences.cn_text: 他关于自我提升和努力工作的故事本身就足以成为一部引人入胜的传记，但其意义远不止于此。
sentences.en_text: His tale of selfimprovement and hard work would make a fascinating biography in its own right, but represents something more than that.

sentences.cn_text: 正如密码破译在西班牙斗争中具有更广泛的意义，他努力攀登晋升阶梯的尝试也深刻反映了英国社会的状况。
sentences.en_text: Just as the code breaking has its wider relevance in the struggle for Spain, so his attempts to make his way up the promotion ladder speak volumes about British society.
